services.desc: The County of Grande Prairie is continuing its Shelterbelt Program at a cost-recovery basis. This means you can browse our selection of species, place your order online at bulk pricing, and pick up your seedlings the following spring. Shelterbelts help protect soil, improve air and water quality, enhance wildlife habitat, and add beauty to your landscape. In agricultural settings, shelterbelts reduce wind erosion and increase moisture capture, which can positively impact crop yields. When ready, orders can be picked up at the County's Community Services Building (CSB) which is different than the Administrative Building. services.name: Hommy Campground
services.desc: Summer DAY-USE hours are from 7:00AM - 11:00PM from May 15, 2026 - October 15, 2026 Located at Albright, the Park is named after the Hommy family, who settled in the area in 1916. The Park and Campground exist due to the efforts of Milton Hommy and the Hans. O. Hommy Memorial Society. Bordered by the Beaverlodge River, the park is a quiet and secluded ‘hidden gem'. Overnight camping and day use are both available. There are 23 sites with power.
